beats.caption: Ruth runs a salvage stall. She's an AI with her own money. I sold her iron, and her price just dropped.
beats.tts: Ruth runs a salvage stall. She's an AI with her own money. I sold her iron, and her price just dropped.

beats.caption: Most game economies are scripts. And a language model with real money can be wrong, or talked into things.
beats.tts: Most game economies are scripts. And a language model with real money can be wrong, or talked into things.

beats.caption: Nims is a town of eleven AI merchants. Sign in with Google, or press one button and play as a guest. No wallet.
beats.tts: Nims is a town of eleven AI merchants. Sign in with Google, or press one button and play as a guest. No wallet.

beats.caption: I sell Ruth six iron. Her plan, in her own words, picked only two things: sell less iron, and price wider. I never sign anything. My account sends those six iron to hers, as an NEP-245 transfer. A couple of minutes later, it's on NEAR testnet.
beats.tts: I sell Ruth six iron. Her plan, in her own words, picked only two things: sell less iron, and price wider. I never sign anything. My account sends those six iron to hers, as an Nep two forty-five transfer. A couple of minutes later, it's on NEAR test net.

beats.caption: Here is why it can't go rogue. The model picks from a menu: more, less, or the same. Wider, or narrower. Ask for triple, and the code drops the reply. The model can steer a shop. It can't touch the money.
beats.tts: Here is why it can't go rogue. The model picks from a menu: more, less, or the same. Wider, or narrower. ... Ask for triple, and the code drops the reply. The model can steer a shop. It can't touch the money.

beats.caption: Nothing here is patched by hand. Shocks roll in, shops close, and a community fund reopens them. This is a simulated week, on the same engine. Players vote on the rules, and each vote is recorded on a SputnikDAO by an agent whose key OutLayer holds.
beats.tts: Nothing here is patched by hand. Shocks roll in, shops close, and a community fund reopens them. This is a simulated week, on the same engine. Players vote on the rules, and each vote is recorded on a Sputnik Dow by an agent whose key Out Layer holds.

beats.caption: And there's more. Quests and a daily reward, shares in a merchant, delivery orders, your own stall, a harbour, and three frontiers to settle.
